import PV_L2C_SampleCanonical
import PV_L2C_DecodeRange
import R1Z.PV_Src_CompilerTactic
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_StateSampler
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_M31
inductive Failure where
  | exhausted

/-- Owned stateful source cut. Next-word calls, exhausted state and every
source Result failure are retained; no distribution law is assumed. -/
def scalar {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) : Nat → S → Result (Except Failure word × S)
  | 0,s => ok (.error .exhausted,s)
  | n+1,s => do
    let (raw,s1) ← next s
    let candidate := raw &&& BitVec.ofNat 32 p
    if candidate.toNat < p then ok (.ok candidate,s1) else scalar next n s1

theorem canonical_result {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (fuel : Nat)
    (s s1 : S) (v : word) (h : scalar next fuel s = ok (.ok v,s1)) : canonical v := by
  induction fuel generalizing s with
  | zero => cases h
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [scalar] at h
    pv_peel h with pair hp
    rcases pair with ⟨raw,after⟩
    change (if (raw &&& BitVec.ofNat 32 p).toNat < p then
      ok (.ok (raw &&& BitVec.ofNat 32 p),after) else scalar next n after) = ok (.ok v,s1) at h
    split at h
    · cases h;assumption
    · exact ih after h
#print axioms canonical_result

abbrev Step (S A : Type) := S → Result (Except Failure A × S)

def bind {S A B : Type} (first : Step S A) (thenStep : A → Step S B) : Step S B := fun s => do
  let (result,s1) ← first s
  match result with
  | .error e => ok (.error e,s1)
  | .ok a => thenStep a s1

def pure {S A : Type} (a : A) : Step S A := fun s => ok (.ok a,s)

theorem bind_returned {S A B : Type} (first : Step S A) (thenStep : A → Step S B)
    (s outState : S) (out : B) (h : bind first thenStep s = ok (.ok out,outState)) :
    ∃ a s1, first s = ok (.ok a,s1) ∧ thenStep a s1 = ok (.ok out,outState) := by
  unfold bind at h
  pv_peel h with pair hp
  rcases pair with ⟨result,s1⟩
  cases result with
  | error e => cases h
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,s1,hp,h⟩
#print axioms bind_returned

def secure {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (fuel : Nat) : Step S PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q :=
  bind (scalar next fuel) (fun a => bind (scalar next fuel) (fun b =>
    bind (scalar next fuel) (fun c => bind (scalar next fuel) (fun d =>
      pure (PV_L2C_SampleCanonical.tuple a b c d)))))

theorem secure_result {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (fuel : Nat)
    (s s1 : S) (q : PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q) (h : secure next fuel s = ok (.ok q,s1)) :
    PV_L2C_NativeQ.Canonical q := by
  unfold secure at h
  obtain ⟨a,sa,ha,h⟩ := bind_returned _ _ _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨b,sb,hb,h⟩ := bind_returned _ _ _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨c,sc,hc,h⟩ := bind_returned _ _ _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨d,sd,hd,h⟩ := bind_returned _ _ _ _ _ h
  cases h
  exact PV_L2C_SampleCanonical.tuple_canonical _ _ _ _
    (canonical_result next fuel s sa a ha) (canonical_result next fuel sa sb b hb)
    (canonical_result next fuel sb sc c hc) (canonical_result next fuel sc s1 d hd)
#print axioms secure_result
end PV_L2C_StateSampler

import PV_L2C_PaddingNative
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_PaddingComplete
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_QFold PV_L2C_PaddingNative
inductive Failure where
  | traceShape

def activeScan (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (padding : Fin 1024 → Q)
    (rows : List (Fin 1024)) : Except Failure Unit :=
  match rows with
  | [] => .ok ()
  | r::rest => if active r && decide (padding r ≠ zero) then .error .traceShape
      else activeScan active padding rest

def applyPadding (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (h1 padding : Fin 1024 → Q)
    (h1Length paddingLength : Nat) : Except Failure (Fin 1024 → Q) := do
  if h1Length ≠ 1024 ∨ paddingLength ≠ 1024 then throw .traceShape
  activeScan active padding (List.finRange 1024)
  if tableSum (inactiveTable active padding) ≠ zero then throw .traceShape
  pure (fun r => addQ (h1 r) (padding r))

theorem scan (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (padding : Fin 1024 → Q)
    (h : ∀ r, (active r && decide (padding r ≠ zero)) = false)
    (rows : List (Fin 1024)) : activeScan active padding rows = .ok () := by
  induction rows with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r rest ih => rw [activeScan,h r];exact ih
#print axioms scan

theorem complete (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Fin 1024) (random h1 : Fin 1024 → Q)
    (hc : ∀ r, Canonical (random r)) (hd : active d = false) :
    applyPadding active h1 (rebalance active d (sample active d random)) 1024 1024 =
      .ok (fun r => addQ (h1 r) (rebalance active d (sample active d random) r)) := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hs⟩ := guard_outcomes active d random hc hd
  unfold applyPadding
  simp only [ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,or_self,↓reduceIte]
  rw [scan active _ ha]
  have hz : tableSum (inactiveTable active (rebalance active d (sample active d random))) = zero := by
    simpa only [decide_eq_false_iff_not,not_not] using hs
  rw [hz]
  simp
#print axioms complete
end PV_L2C_PaddingComplete

import PV_L2C_StateSampler
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_SamplerFill
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_StateSampler

def fill {S A : Type} (sample : Step S A) : Nat → Step S (List A)
  | 0 => pure []
  | n+1 => bind sample (fun a => bind (fill sample n) (fun rest => pure (a::rest)))

theorem returned {S A : Type} (sample : Step S A) (pred : A → Prop)
    (hs : ∀ s s1 a, sample s = ok (.ok a,s1) → pred a)
    (n : Nat) (s s1 : S) (values : List A)
    (h : fill sample n s = ok (.ok values,s1)) :
    values.length = n ∧ ∀ a ∈ values, pred a := by
  induction n generalizing s values with
  | zero => cases h;exact ⟨rfl,by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fill] at h
    obtain ⟨a,after,ha,h⟩ := bind_returned _ _ _ _ _ h
    obtain ⟨rest,last,hr,h⟩ := bind_returned _ _ _ _ _ h
    cases h
    obtain ⟨hl,hc⟩ := ih after rest hr
    refine ⟨by simpa using hl,?_⟩
    intro b hb
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb with he | ht
    · subst b;exact hs s after a ha
    · exact hc b ht
#print axioms returned

theorem scalar {S : Type} (next : S → Result (PV_L2C_M31.word × S))
    (n fuel : Nat) (s s1 : S) (values : List PV_L2C_M31.word)
    (h : fill (PV_L2C_StateSampler.scalar next fuel) n s = ok (.ok values,s1)) :
    values.length = n ∧ ∀ a ∈ values, PV_L2C_M31.canonical a :=
  returned _ _ (fun s s1 a ha => canonical_result next fuel s s1 a ha) n s s1 values h
#print axioms scalar

theorem secure {S : Type} (next : S → Result (PV_L2C_M31.word × S))
    (n fuel : Nat) (s s1 : S) (values : List PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q)
    (h : fill (PV_L2C_StateSampler.secure next fuel) n s = ok (.ok values,s1)) :
    values.length = n ∧ ∀ a ∈ values, PV_L2C_NativeQ.Canonical a :=
  returned _ _ (fun s s1 a ha => secure_result next fuel s s1 a ha) n s s1 values h
#print axioms secure
end PV_L2C_SamplerFill

import PV_L2C_NativeBalance
import PV_L2C_PaddingNative
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_N4Control
open PV_L2C_M31 PV_L2C_NativeQ

def count (sums : List word) : Nat :=
  sums.foldl (fun n sum => if sum = 0 then n+1 else n) 0

theorem fold_count (sums : List word) (h : ∀ s ∈ sums, s = 0) (start : Nat) :
    sums.foldl (fun n sum => if sum = 0 then n+1 else n) start = start+sums.length := by
  induction sums generalizing start with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s rest ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons,if_pos (h s (by simp)),ih (by intro v hv;exact h v (by simp [hv]))]
    simp;omega
#print axioms fold_count

theorem counted (sums : List word) (h : ∀ s ∈ sums, s = 0) : count sums = sums.length := by
  simpa only [count,Nat.zero_add] using fold_count sums h 0
#print axioms counted

structure Audit where
  c1Columns : Nat
  maskOnlyColumns : Nat
  dBalanced : Bool
  gBalanced : Bool
  paddingBalanced : Bool
inductive Failure where
  | semantic

def guard (audit : Audit) : Except Failure Unit :=
  if audit.c1Columns ≠ 16 ∨ audit.maskOnlyColumns ≠ 10 ∨
    audit.dBalanced = false ∨ audit.gBalanced = false ∨ audit.paddingBalanced = false
  then .error .semantic else .ok ()

theorem complete (c1 maskOnly : List word) (h1 : c1.length = 16) (h2 : maskOnly.length = 10)
    (hc1 : ∀ s ∈ c1, s = 0) (hc2 : ∀ s ∈ maskOnly, s = 0) :
    guard ⟨count c1,count maskOnly,true,true,true⟩ = .ok () := by
  rw [counted c1 hc1,counted maskOnly hc2,h1,h2]
  rfl
#print axioms complete
end PV_L2C_N4Control

import Mathlib.Algebra.GroupPower.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Tactic
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_InverseChain

def chain {M : Type} [Monoid M] (x : M) : M :=
  let t2 := (x*x)*x
  let t4 := t2^(2^2)*t2
  let t8 := t4^(2^4)*t4
  let t16 := t8^(2^8)*t8
  let t24 := t16^(2^8)*t8
  let t28 := t24^(2^4)*t4
  let t29 := (t28*t28)*x
  let t30 := t29*t29
  (t30*t30)*x

/-- The frozen 38-multiplication chain is checked symbolically; no concrete
field inverse or generated recurrence is normalized. -/
theorem exponent {M : Type} [Monoid M] (x : M) : chain x = x^2147483645 := by
  have h2 : (x*x)*x = x^3 := by simp [pow_succ]
  have h4 : (x^3)^(2^2)*x^3 = x^15 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h8 : (x^15)^(2^4)*x^15 = x^255 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h16 : (x^255)^(2^8)*x^255 = x^65535 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h24 : (x^65535)^(2^8)*x^255 = x^16777215 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h28 : (x^16777215)^(2^4)*x^15 = x^268435455 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h29 : (x^268435455*x^268435455)*x = x^536870911 := by
    rw [← pow_add,← pow_succ]
  have h30 : x^536870911*x^536870911 = x^1073741822 := by rw [← pow_add]
  unfold chain
  rw [h2,h4,h8,h16,h24,h28,h29,h30,← pow_add,← pow_succ]
#print axioms exponent
end PV_L2C_InverseChain
